metas.name: Swipe Right on the Devil

metas.name: Cape Fear

metas.name: The Pet Cemetery Murders: A Ghost Story

Eileen and her husband Keen are convinced that Dana Chandler, the woman accused of killing her ex-husband and his girlfriend, did not commit the crime and devote their lives to fighting for Chandler's innocence. Available on HBO Max in 4K.

metas.name: The Nightmare Upstairs: What Happened to Ty and Bryn?

Available on Hulu in 1080p.

metas.name: Somebody Knows Something

metas.name: Unmasking a Monster: Aileen Wuornos

metas.name: Chilean Mine Rescue: Race Against Time

metas.name: Africa Earth's Wild Home
